lead.alt: Florida offensive line coach Phil Trautwein and his family celebrate the win over Ole Miss. Photo by Chris Spears.
lead.deck: Franz Beard drives home from Jon Sumrall’s Monday press conference, flashes back to Florida’s 27-0 win over Georgia in 1984, and sees the same kind of offensive line taking shape now.

cover.deck: 1984 to now. A song on I-75, a line that moves the pile, and a coach who won't look at the poll.
cover.headline: Something happened along the way.
